command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/inherited-directory-acls/projects
check=$base/.acl-inheritance-check
test ! -e "$check"
runuser -u designer -- sh -c 'umask 077; mkdir "$1"; mkdir "$1/subdir"; printf "%s\n" designer-created > "$1/document.txt"; printf "%s\n" nested > "$1/subdir/nested.txt"' sh "$check"
printf '%s\n' '--- inherited ACLs ---'
getfacl -p "$check" "$check/document.txt" "$check/subdir" "$check/subdir/nested.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- reviewer access ---'
runuser -u reviewer -- sh -c 'cat "$1/document.txt"; printf "%s\n" reviewer-updated >> "$1/document.txt"; printf "%s\n" reviewer-created > "$1/subdir/reviewer-note.txt"' sh "$check"
cat "$check/document.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- visitor denial ---'
if runuser -u visitor -- ls "$base" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR visitor listed project'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'visitor cannot list project: PASS'; fi
if runuser -u visitor -- cat "$check/document.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR visitor read document'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'visitor cannot read document: PASS'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- ownership and existing content ---'
stat -c '%U:%G %A %n' "$check" "$check/document.txt" "$check/subdir" "$check/subdir/nested.txt" "$base/brief.txt"
sha256sum "$base/brief.txt"
